closes.owner: device auth, pairing auth, unknown websocket path
closes.meaning: Credential check failed, the device is disabled, the pairing secret is wrong, or the websocket path is not a protocol path. Disabled devices and bad secrets use the same reason.
The auth frame version is not Protocol v1. The socket closes after an auth_result error frame.
No successful first frame before the auth timeout. The Durable Object alarm closes the socket on the next sweep after the timeout.
The authenticated device socket missed the heartbeat stale window.
A newer authenticated socket replaced this one.
The pair request expired while the socket was waiting.
An administrator replaced the device credential. The Mac should stop reconnecting until it has the new credential.
An administrator disabled the device. The Mac should stop reconnecting.
The connection registry is closing sockets. The Mac may reconnect.
Pairing authentication failed for a reason other than a rejected credential.

httpErrors.meaning: Missing or invalid Shortcut token, or invalid administrator sign-in. Unknown users and wrong passwords share one message. Device websocket failures stay on invalid_credentials and do not say whether the device exists.
The token cannot perform the operation, is not device-scoped, or is scoped to a different device.
The device id is not registered.
The device exists and is disabled. The command is not queued.
The device has no authenticated socket. The command is not queued.
The action is not an active Protocol v1 action, or the connected agent did not report it.
The request is malformed, an API path is unknown, or the body exceeds the limit.
The device did not return command_result before the server timeout. The HTTP body is status timeout, not an error envelope.
The command was not accepted because too many commands are already in flight.
The caller exceeded the command or sign-in rate limit.
Unexpected server failure. The response does not include exception detail.
A mutating admin request came from an origin that is not allowed.
